jobs.description:
Who are we?
Amazon Advertising builds and manages systems with high performance and availability. We serve and respond to hundreds of billions of requests annually, and have ambitions to grow that number several orders of magnitude, while maintaining response latencies in the milliseconds and meeting strict SLA requirements. We delight in data, and are constantly trying to enrich our models and make more informed decisions using every bit and byte we have.

This role is in our bidding data and analytics team. We operate at scale, making sense of terabytes of hourly data. Our data outputs power multiple critical parts of the Advertising business, and we operate with high-availability principles. We're at a point of rapid change, both for our business and our architecture, bringing numerous opportunities for strategic and design-level thinking. We seek to leverage industry standards (OpenRTB, VAST, Native, etc) when suitable, and define new standards when appropriate to help the ad tech industry evolve and improve.

Who are you?
You are a strong Software Development Engineer who is passionate about performance and efficiency in a real time system and big data. You have demonstrable experience in diving deep into performance critical systems where every single millisecond of latency matters. You have broad experience in Ad Tech systems and bring you understanding of the Ads ecosystem to hit the road running on day one.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, Develop, Implement greenfield real time Systems from the ground up
- Champion team processes using software development best practices
- Propose innovative tools, frameworks, automations and processes for maintaining the system performance standards
- Write clean, maintainable code and perform peer code-reviews. Drive improvements to the code review process. (CDK, Java, Rust, Python)
- Deep-dive into client or server systems to optimize for performance, maintainability, scalability, extensibility as needed.
- Assist in the career development of others by actively mentoring individuals and the community on advanced technical issues and helping managers guide the career growth of their team members.
Utilize deep knowledge of tech fundamentals to build things that can operate at AWS-stressing scale.

회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.
직무 소개
쿠팡 CS 조직에서 운영되는 AI 서비스의 품질을 책임지는 팀입니다.고객 경험에 직접 영향을 미치는 AI 산출물을 분석하고, 모델이 더 잘 동작할 수 있도록 개선 방향을 도출합니다. AI가 실제 서비스에서 어떻게 작동하는지 가장 가까이에서 이해하고 싶은 분께 적합한 포지션입니다.

jobs.description: Overview Jackson Healthcare and our family of companies provide healthcare systems, hospitals and medical facilities of all sizes with the skilled and specialized labor and technologies they need to deliver high quality patient care and achieve the best possible outcomes — while connecting healthcare professionals to the temporary engagements, contract assignments and permanent placement employment opportunities they desire. Headquartered in metro Atlanta, we’re powered by more than 2,600 associates and over 20,000 clinician providers covering all 50 U.S. states. Our mission is to improve the delivery of patient care and the lives of everyone we touch. This includes the patients, clinicians and healthcare executives we work with through our companies every day, as well as our communities, the nonprofit organizations we support and each associate who is part of our family. We’re always looking to add new talent to our teams. We value diverse professionals at all levels and across multiple disciplines and areas of expertise, who have strong leadership skills, align with our culture, and are committed to excellence. This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role for an exceptional writer and storyteller who is comfortable owning projects end-to-end — from research and drafting, through publishing, and measuring cross-channel performance and impact. Day to day, the Senior Content Marketing Specialist will write, edit, and optimize blog posts, articles, bylines, and other long-form content; create video storyboards and scripts; and develop, publish, and manage written and multi-media content across various channels. The role will conceive fresh story ideas and maintain an editorial content calendar that keeps content timely, relevant, and aligned with audience needs, industry trends, and business priorities. Support social strategy and tactics, including contributing content for organic and paid social campaigns. Maintain and enforce brand voice, style guidelines and editorial standards across content deliverables. Team player with a customer-centric approach and a track record of reliability and follow-through. Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Ability to shift focus as business needs evolve. A natural curiosity around performance and metrics, and a drive to test, measure, analyze and optimize content for search engines, answer engines and readers alike. A curiosity and interest in keeping abreast of emerging technologies and creative strategies to stay on the forefront of the role and content marketing space. A deep commitment to Jackson Healthcare's mission and core values and a commitment to serving others. jobs.description: Become a part of our caring community The Senior Software Engineer on Team Caliber builds and maintains the NBA platform's business rules engine — the system that determines member eligibility, suppression, frequency, and consent before any action is taken. Team Caliber is built in Java with the Drools rules engine and integrates with the rest of the platform through APIs and a Kafka event backbone. This is a hands-on backend-leaning full stack role for an engineer who writes clean, well-tested Java, reasons carefully about complex conditional logic, and cares about getting correctness right in a system where rules carry compliance weight. Key Responsibilities • Rules engine development — Design, build, and maintain business rules in Java and Drools that govern eligibility, suppression, frequency capping, and consent. • Backend services — Build and own the Java/Spring services and REST APIs that expose the rules engine to the rest of the platform. • Event integration — Produce and consume Kafka events to connect the rules engine to upstream signals and downstream decisioning and activation. • Correctness and testing — Write thorough tests for rule logic and services; treat rule correctness as a first-class, auditable concern. • Performance — Keep rule evaluation fast and predictable as the ruleset and traffic grow. • Quality — Run and participate in code reviews, uphold engineering standards, and ship production-ready code in a PHI-handling environment. • Collaboration — Partner with Product and compliance to turn business and regulatory requirements into clear, maintainable rules. Use your skills to make an impact Required Qualifications • Bachelor's degree in computer science or relevant field • 5+ years of software engineering experience with strong Java and Spring/Spring Boot skills. • Experience building and maintaining backend services and REST APIs in production. • Comfort designing and reasoning about complex conditional/business logic. • Working knowledge of event-driven integration and Kafka producer/consumer patterns. • Experience operating on cloud infrastructure (Azure or equivalent) with containers/Kubernetes and CI/CD. • Strong testing discipline and attention to correctness. • Clear communicator across engineering, product, and compliance. Preferred Qualifications • Hands-on experience with the Drools rules engine or another business rules management system (BRMS). • Familiarity with front-end work (React/TypeScript) to support rule-authoring or admin interfaces. • Experience in healthcare, insurance, or another regulated industry where business rules encode compliance requirements. • Familiarity with Helm/Terraform for Kubernetes deployment. Success Indicators State transitions are precise, deterministic, and resilient to retries Side effects reliably occur exactly once, even during failures or replays Systems recover gracefully from crashes and redeployments AI-driven tooling decreases defect rates and expedites debugging The state layer is trusted as the definitive source of truth across engineering teams Why This Role is Critical In contemporary automated platforms, correctness and reliability hinge on the integrity of state, not just requests. This role ensures that every state transition and side effect is executed once—and only once—providing a solid foundation for trust, reliability, compliance, and scalability throughout the system. Creative Cloud is Adobe’s suite of creative tools including Photoshop, Illustrator, and Premiere Pro, which are used by millions of creatives worldwide. AI is transforming how people create. There’s an opportunity to simplify our plans and packaging so customers can easily find and understand the plan that’s right for them.

We are seeking a strategic Group Product Marketing Manager to own how Creative Cloud is packaged, new AI products get monetized, and AI features launch across Creative Cloud products. You will lead a team responsible for this work and set the direction for how it comes together. This is a horizontal role: you’ll work across Product, Finance, and Marketing teams to give Creative Cloud a single point of view on packaging, monetization, and launches. The right candidate will be comfortable with ambiguity, energized by big cross-functional problems, and confident enough to build and defend a point of view.

What You’ll Do

•

Develop the Creative Cloud offering strategy: Use customer and market insights to define how plans are structured and priced across the portfolio, balancing customer value with business goals.

•

Define and oversee a testing roadmap: Build a roadmap for new packaging, pricing, and positioning concepts, and translate results into a go-to-market strategy.

•

Drive GenAI adoption and monetization for creative professionals: Evolve Adobe's AI monetization approach for new AI-powered capabilities, including agentic. You will build product roadmaps, lead all aspects of customer-facing messaging, and track performance.

•

Lead and develop your PMM team: Manage and grow a team of senior IC PMMs by fostering professional development, providing direction on execution, and removing roadblocks.

•

Build cross-functional alignment: Partner with Product, Finance, Marketing, and other teams to drive initiatives forward without direct authority over them.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

•

10+ years in product marketing or a related strategy role.

•

6+ years of experience in managing people.

•

Experience with pricing, packaging, or monetization strategy for a subscription or software business.

•

Experience bringing new or emerging technology products to market.

•

A track record leading cross-functional initiatives that span multiple product lines.

•

Excellent executive communication skills and a passion for storytelling.

•

You are data-driven, with the ability to interpret data to inform and use it to improve performance.

•

BS degree in Marketing, Business or a related degree is preferred OR 10+ years of Marketing experience or equivalent practical experience

MBA or equivalent experience is a plus.

jobs.description: Job Description The Role As a Lead System Integration Engineer – Enterprise Transformation, you will design, build, and scale enterprise integrations and data pipelines that modernize how systems work together across General Motors. 회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 리테일 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 유지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (Always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (High-tech), 초연결사회 (Hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

직무 소개
Large Customer Sales (LCS) 팀은 쿠팡 내 주요 브랜드 및 중대형 광고주를 대상으로 광고 성과를 극대화하고 장기적인 비즈니스 성장을 지원하는 조직입니다.

jobs.description: Build the foundational infrastructure to capture, process, store, and analyze petabyte-scale log-level advertising data — delivering unprecedented transparency into the programmatic supply chain for Amazon's most strategic advertising partners. Your work will directly empower teams to understand auction competitiveness, identify revenue opportunities, optimize floor pricing, and ensure supply chain integrity. We own and operate the premier advanced analytics capability within Amazon Ads, delivering innovative AI, modeling, and data solutions that help Holding Companies, independent agencies, technology integrators, and large-scale advertisers make smarter, faster, and more impactful advertising decisions. Log-level data — granular, non-aggregated, event-level information from ad servers, exchanges, and SSPs — provides advertisers with visibility into individual ad impressions, bid prices, viewability scores, and supply path. This is a greenfield infrastructure challenge at massive scale, and you'll be building it from the ground up. Key job responsibilities - Implement and maintain scalable data pipelines to ingest, process, and store petabyte-scale log-level advertising data from multiple sources (ad servers, exchanges, SSPs) - Build ETL workflows that transform raw event-level data into queryable, analysis-ready formats following established architectural patterns and best practices - Create and maintain APIs that enable analytics teams and data scientists to query log-level data efficiently - Implement data quality checks, validation logic, and monitoring for data pipelines and services - Optimize performance and cost efficiency of data processing jobs and queries - Write clean, well-tested code and participate in code reviews to maintain high engineering standards - Collaborate with senior engineers to contribute to design discussions and architectural decisions - Debug and resolve production issues, participating in on-call rotations as needed - Document systems, processes, and runbooks to support operational excellence

jobs.description: Director, Enterprise Content Strategy & Newsrooms About the role The Cigna Group is seeking a strategic, audience-focused leader to oversee enterprise content strategy and owned external content across The Cigna Group, Cigna Healthcare and Evernorth Health Services Newsrooms. This leader will build and direct an integrated enterprise content system that translates business priorities, customer and patient needs, clinical expertise, data and research, and public affairs insights into clear, credible and useful content. The role will connect enterprise storytelling across owned, earned, paid, social, executive and internal channels so that priority stories are planned together, reach the right audiences, and deliver measurable business and reputation impact. Key responsibilities Lead enterprise content strategy Define and continually evolve the enterprise content strategy in alignment with The Cigna Group’s business strategy, enterprise narrative and priority audiences. Translate enterprise and business priorities into a focused portfolio of content themes, campaigns and editorial opportunities. Lead the enterprise editorial planning process, including annual, quarterly and always-on planning across the three Newsrooms and broader content ecosystem. Serve as a strategic adviser to senior Communications, Marketing, Social Media and business leaders on content priorities, audience strategy and owned-media opportunities. Oversee The Cigna Group’s enterprise Newsrooms Set the vision, distinctive role and strategic priorities for The Cigna Group, Cigna Healthcare and Evernorth Health Services Newsrooms. Oversee the editorial calendar and content portfolio across articles, executive perspectives, explainers, multimedia stories, research, data-driven content, podcasts, video and other emerging formats. Establish clear criteria for what should be published, where it should appear, and how it should be activated beyond the Newsroom. Maintain high standards for accuracy, clarity, credibility, accessibility, brand voice and compliance. Establish enterprise governance and operating discipline Lead a cross-functional enterprise planning forum that prioritizes key topics, audiences, moments and outcomes. Develop scalable workflows for content intake, prioritization, development, review, publishing, distribution and optimization. Create practical standards, tools and templates that help teams apply the enterprise content strategy consistently. Balance centralized enterprise direction with the expertise and needs of business, functional and channel teams. Use data, search and AI to improve content impact Refine content measurement framework aligned to audience, reputation and business outcomes. Partner with measurement and analytics teams to establish performance dashboards, benchmarks and learning agendas across the Newsrooms and content campaigns. Use audience data, search behavior, social listening, earned-media insights and content performance to refine priorities and improve results. Establish standards for SEO, answer-engine optimization and generative-engine optimization so enterprise content is readily discoverable and understandable across traditional search and AI-powered platforms. Champion responsible use of AI-enabled tools to improve research, planning, content adaptation, tagging, workflow efficiency and performance analysis. Create a test-and-learn culture that evaluates new formats, distribution methods and audience-engagement approaches. Ideal candidates will offer 12 or more years of experience in enterprise content strategy, corporate communications, content marketing, brand journalism, digital publishing, editorial leadership or a related field. Demonstrated experience leading content strategy across a large, matrixed organization with multiple businesses, brands or stakeholder groups. Experience leading owned-media platforms, corporate Newsrooms, content hubs or enterprise editorial programs. Strong understanding of integrated communications across owned, earned, paid, social, executive and internal channels. Experience establishing content governance, editorial planning processes and cross-functional operating models. Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and align stakeholders without relying solely on direct authority. Strong command of audience analytics, content performance measurement, SEO and emerging AI-driven discovery practices. Excellent editorial judgment and the ability to simplify complex health care, business, clinical and policy topics without sacrificing accuracy. Experience developing content for sophisticated external audiences, including investors, employers, policymakers, clinicians, customers and patients. jobs.description: Career Category Engineering Job Description Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do. Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives. Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career. Device Engineering Sr. Engineer What you will do Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will join our Device Engineering group to support device development and engineering robustness. In support of Amgen’s mission to serve patients, the Device Engineering group at Amgen is a diverse team working to identify, develop, commercialize, and continuously improve drug delivery devices to optimize the patient experience. The Sr Engineer role is a cross-discipline execution role within the Design for Robustness framework. The role ensures consistent and structured application of robustness methodologies across mechanical design projects, integrating insights from device performance, sources of variation, load cases, materials, assembly, and manufacturing perspectives. While not serving as the formal discipline authority, the role strengthens project robustness execution and supports discipline SMEs under centralized governance. The Sr Engineer operates across disciplines and may execute within individual Design for Robustness disciplines; Kinematic Design, Tolerance Design, Structural Strength Design, Material Design, DFA, DFM, depending on project needs and targeted training. The position is based at our Amgen Massachusetts site with the possibility of a flexible working arrangement meeting business and private needs. You will be joining Amgen device development team consisting of 50+ engineers. This position will report to the Robustness Disciplines Lead. Responsibilities: Independently execute tasks within one or more of the Design for Robustness disciplines; Kinematic Design, Tolerance Design, Structural Strength Design, Material Design, DFA, DFM. Provide technical recommendations to improve design performance, reduce sensitivity to variation, and enhance overall system robustness Collaborate across robustness disciplines to identify risks and mitigations, opportunities and best trade-off solutions. Contribute to continuous improvement of robustness disciplines and tools by identifying gaps, proposing improvements, and supporting implementation under governance frameworks. Interface effectively with discipline SMEs and incorporating guidance while maintaining ownership of robustness execution within assigned scope Drive structured problem-solving and root cause analysis for design, test, and field performance issues, ensuring robust corrective solutions. Collaborate closely with manufacturing, quality, and suppliers to improve product robustness and reduce variation-driven failures. Apply systems-level thinking to anticipate how design decisions impact downstream manufacturability and performance. What we expect of you We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The Engineer professional we seek is an individual with these qualifications. Basic Qualifications: Doctorate degree OR Master’s degree and 2 years of Engineering experience OR Bachelor’s degree and 4 years of Engineering experience OR Associate’s degree and 8 years Engineering experience OR High school diploma / GED and 10 years of Engineering experience Preferred Qualifications: 5+ years of progressive experience as a mechanical engineer. 3+ years of experience within development of Medical Devices, ideally Class II and Class III. Experience in mechanical engineering disciplines and tools, with hands-on work in at least one Design for Robustness disciplines; Kinematic Design, Tolerance Design, Structural Strength Design, Material Design, DFA, DFM, and preferably exposure to several . Strong interpersonal skills Ability to work within cross-cultural project teams Systematic problem solver and solution developer also when presented with conflicting needs and technical issues. Experience in drug/device combination product design and development Technical understanding of manufacturing processes (injection molding, assembly processes) Technical understanding of drawings and design documentation. Understands documentation flow for GMP deliverables Knowledge of Quality Management System, Quality Management Policy and applicable laws and regulations as they apply to this job type/position Familiar with: US Good Manufacturing Practices - 21CFR820; Quality Management - ISO 13485; Needle-based injection systems for medical use - ISO 11608; Risk Management - ISO 14971. Strong communication and presentation skills Fluent in English language What you can expect of us As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. jobs.description: Meet the Team: Cisco’s ASIC (Application-Specific Integrated Circuit) Engineering team is at the heart of our networking innovation. They are responsible for the end-to-end design, development, and verification of high-performance, custom silicon that powers the world’s most critical network infrastructure. By engineering bespoke chips, the team enables unparalleled throughput, energy efficiency, and advanced security features, ensuring our routers, switches, and optical platforms can handle the massive data demands of today’s digital landscape. Working at the intersection of hardware architecture and software integration, this team is essential to maintaining Cisco’s leadership in networking technology, pushing the boundaries of what is possible in silicon design to solve complex connectivity challenges. Your Impact: The Foundry/OSAT Manager (ASIC Engineering Technical Leader) is responsible for the operational success of our packaging programs. You will manage the business and operational relationship with TSMC and OSAT partners, ensuring that capacity, cost, and delivery schedules are met. You bridge the gap between technical requirements and business execution. Key Responsibilities: Vendor Management: Manage the strategic relationship with TSMC and OSAT partners. Lead business reviews, capacity planning, and contract negotiations. Program Execution: Oversee the end-to-end NPI-to-HVM (High Volume Manufacturing) process. Ensure that technical milestones defined by the Engineering Leader are met on time and within budget. Resource & Budget Management: Manage the department budget, headcount, and resource allocation to support multiple product lines. Risk Mitigation: Identify and manage supply chain risks. Develop contingency plans for capacity constraints or manufacturing disruptions. Cross-Functional Leadership: Act as the primary interface between the technical team and internal stakeholders (Finance, Procurement, Product Management). Minimum Qualifications: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering or Business (MBA is a plus) 15+ years of experience in semiconductor supply chain, foundry operations, or OSAT management Strong track record of managing large-scale manufacturing programs with TSMC Excellent project management skills (PMP or equivalent experience) 5+ years of proven management experience in a high-tech environment, with a focus on supply chain operations, vendor management, and team development Preferred Qualifications: PMP or equivalent certifications SiOps Why Cisco? At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
